natural.method: Each real match snapshot is copied into paired control/treatment branches for both camps. One bonus is granted to the original ball; all pre-existing effects and balls stay active. Floor pickups and future spawns stay active: this includes indirect pickup benefits but bonus-specific RNG use can change subsequent loot, increasing variance. Extra cells means treatment ownership minus control ownership. RNG starts equal but bonus-specific RNG use is retained. Territory trajectories can diverge chaotically; these contextual marginal effects are neither universal power rankings nor a win-probability estimate. Completed branches freeze at victory.

isolated.method: Each real match snapshot is copied into paired control/treatment branches for both camps. One bonus is granted to the original ball; all pre-existing effects and balls stay active. Floor pickups and future spawns are removed identically from both branches; indirect benefits from subsequent loot are NOT measured. Extra cells means treatment ownership minus control ownership. RNG starts equal but bonus-specific RNG use is retained. Territory trajectories can diverge chaotically; these contextual marginal effects are neither universal power rankings nor a win-probability estimate. Completed branches freeze at victory.
